title: 네덜란드 Pivot 물량표 원화 단가·주문분배 전체교체 계약

actions.name: DUTCH_PIVOT_LIVE_READ
actions.source: authenticated GET /api/stats/pivot-weeks loads exact OrderYear-scoped OrderMaster subweeks plus positive Netherlands-filtered dbo.ViewWarehouse.OutQuantity subweeks; selector is their union and the initial week is the latest Netherlands inbound week, falling back to latest order week only when no Netherlands inbound exists. The selected recorded subweek is sent to /api/stats/pivot-data as explicit orderYear + exact weekStart + weekEnd; extract Netherlands positive customer-product order quantities only

actions.name: DUTCH_PIVOT_WORKBOOK_UPLOAD
actions.source: optional client-side upload of the existing Pivot statistics workbook; extract positive customer-product quantity cells only

actions.name: DUTCH_PIVOT_CELL_QUANTITY_EDIT
actions.source: clicking a populated numeric or blank cell inside a verified customer-by-product matrix opens an inline nonnegative decimal editor; committing a positive value in a blank cell adds a sourceCellDraft row to the browser draft/localStorage and final workbook quantity at that original coordinate, explicit blank-cell zero remains equivalent to no source row; populated-cell Enter or blur commits zero or positive quantity; Escape cancels; invalid or blank input cancels; recalculate row 주문 summaries and customer/order 합계 immediately in the visible draft and exported workbook while preserving 입고/재고 summaries; preserve bounded per-cell quantityHistory in browser drafts and immutable saved work snapshots, with a compact clickable history count and before/after timestamps; all edits invalidate prior preview/plan; no shared ERP write occurs until the existing separately acknowledged apply flow

actions.name: DUTCH_WEEKDAY_LOCAL_EDIT
actions.source: clicking a customer weekday cell in workbook row 2 opens an inline text editor; Enter or blur commits and Escape cancels. The edit is scoped to the visible customer matrix before the 주문 summary column, stored in browser localStorage and included in saved workbook snapshots/Excel export. It never changes ERP Customer data, quantities, preview, plan token or apply payload.

actions.name: DUTCH_PRICE_DRAFT
actions.source: browser localStorage keyed by source identity stores KRW price draft, weekday edits and saved bulk-price config; a separate browser preference preserves the chosen grouping across workbooks. Bulk config has enabled plus excluded source-customer identities; default enables bulk and excludes vendors whose source display name contains 주광. Included vendors share same product/color prices subject to existing explicit rematch safeguards; excluded vendors use their own customer-product price. Toggling config migrates common values to new keys, preserves old draft keys, and never picks among conflicting individual prices; collisions are announced and require review. Every config/price edit invalidates preview/plan; ERP is unchanged until its separate explicit acknowledgement/apply flow

actions.name: DUTCH_SOURCE_SHEET_COMPACT_MATCHING
actions.source: keep the Pivot matrix as the primary view; reduce the fixed flower/item/color and customer widths to show more uniform quantity columns at 1920x1080; stack each customer name above its CL/order code in the customer header cell. Only current unmatched product/customer mappings show a concise red 미매칭 action adjacent to the product name or customer header and open the corresponding editable mapping row. Hide all success/matched status labels and per-cell 매칭 links; never fuzzy-map ambiguous names.

actions.name: DUTCH_PRICE_WORKBOOK_EXPORT
actions.source: reuse the Pivot statistics Netherlands volume workbook and preserve its product/color/customer/summary/farm columns, merges, colors, borders, styles and formulas; normalize every Netherlands customer column to the same 10-character width and let Excel wrap customer names naturally at available word/glyph boundaries while keeping CL/order code on its own lower line; keep each quantity cell numeric and unchanged, top-aligned; put unit-price digits only in a compact zero-inset bordered rectangle sized tightly to the digits and centered inside the lower portion of that same quantity cell; no pointer, no adjacent cell overlap; set only priced rows to a sufficient 30pt height; do not add worksheet columns or visible price caption/@/currency text

actions.name: DUTCH_WORK_SNAPSHOT_SAVE
actions.source: authenticated owner-scoped create-only server JSON under data/runtime; immutable original workbook plus current entries/prices, bulk-price enabled/excluded-customer config and saved year/week/name; server owns UUID, savedAt and savedBy; exclude match cache, preview, planToken, apply job and result

actions.name: DUTCH_WORK_SNAPSHOT_RESTORE
actions.source: authenticated owner-only list/detail; explicit confirmation replaces current browser edits with saved immutable scope; local draft and current year never override the saved year/week; restored work has no valid plan and requires a fresh DUTCH_VOLUME_PREVIEW

actions.name: DUTCH_WORK_FINALIZE_REVIEW
actions.source: prominent 작업 완료·ERP 업로드 검토 action runs the existing fresh preview and opens its visible review; it never writes ERP and the separate final apply button remains mandatory

actions.name: DUTCH_WORK_PRE_APPLY_ARCHIVE
actions.source: after explicit review acknowledgement and immediately before the ERP apply POST, create an immutable snapshot of that exact edited work; freeze editing and duplicate actions while saving; if archival fails send no ERP apply request; never store planToken or apply result

actions.name: DUTCH_VOLUME_PREVIEW
actions.source: authenticated JSON POST, explicit year+week; Netherlands Product.CountryFlower CATEGORY_REPLACE; missing customer/product shipment pair becomes final zero and shows before/after/delta; explicit invalid keys fail closed; user-bound single-use plan token and complete locked-scope digest

actions.name: DUTCH_APPLY_PROGRESS_AND_CORRECTION
actions.source: retain every row-level apply log and final verification record for a plan of up to 5,000 input rows; on failure reload the owner-scoped final progress snapshot; after the atomic transaction releases, allow the user to correct the local draft and require a fresh preview/plan before another apply. Editing remains disabled during the active transaction to prevent a plan/input mismatch or duplicate write.

actions.name: DUTCH_VOLUME_APPLY
actions.source: server-owned planToken and jobId only; same-year active order preserved, absent positive order created; final ShipmentDetail.OutQuantity SET; optional explicit KRW unitPrice including zero changes ShipmentDetail and ShipmentDate Cost/Amount/Vat in same locked transaction; missing unitPrice preserves existing price; fixed/stale/duplicate/farm-conflict fails all; snapshot and in-tx readback required

criteriaLedger.authority: default source is authenticated read-only pivot-data with explicit year/week; selectable weeks come only from the selected OrderYear's active OrderMaster records because Dutch customer quantities are OrderDetail-based; uploaded workbook remains an optional alternate source
criteriaLedger.sheetDetection: sheet name or first three rows must contain 네덜란드, Netherlands, Holland or Dutch
criteriaLedger.header: row 3 headers explicitly distinguish legacy flower/item two-label columns and 꽃/품목명/칼라 three-label columns; 주문 marks the end of customer quantities. Customer name is the top line and CL/order code the lower line. Original sheet labels remain immutable metadata. Arbitrary uploaded _keymap is never trusted; only the freshly generated authenticated LIVE workbook may map an exact unique customer header to an active CustKey included in the same selected year/week pivot response.
criteriaLedger.sheetUi: default workbook matrix preserves source row/column order, headers and merges; customer weekday cells in row 2 are click-editable local workbook metadata, persisted in browser localStorage and work snapshots and included in Excel export. Weekday edits never change ERP Customer, quantity entries, preview, plan token or apply payload. Populated numeric and verified blank customer×product quantity cells open an inline editor on click. A positive commit in a blank cell appends one sourceCellDraft row, persists it in the existing localStorage draft, restores it with the same workbook identity, and writes its quantity into the original workbook coordinate on export. Explicit zero in an otherwise blank cell leaves it blank; populated cell Enter/blur commits finite quantity >=0. Escape cancels; invalid/blank edits cancel; formulas, labels, totals, non-customer summary cells are never editable. Every quantity commit invalidates any previous preview/plan and requires a fresh preview before apply. The adjacent price/matching tab shares entries/prices state. The separate 단가 action opens the price/matching editor; explicit zero price displays as zero, blank preserves ERP price. Tabs alone never reset a draft or trigger ERP writes. Search opens seeded from the original item name, not the flower category.
criteriaLedger.keyboardMatchUi: the source matrix uses compact fixed columns [96,160,76] and 52px customer columns with 14px table text and 15px bold quantities. All primary controls are reachable by Tab/Shift+Tab. Arrow keys move focus among controls in the matrix; text/numeric input cursor movement remains native. Unmatched item/vendor controls open a separate same-origin popup without replacing the board. The popup shows the original query, accepts product/vendor selection, uses ArrowUp/ArrowDown to focus candidates, Enter to choose, Tab to move normally, and Escape or cancel to close. Selection is validated as a positive ERP key and updates only the local matching draft; cancel/close does not mutate the ERP. The opener accepts messages only from the exact tracked popup and token, then restores focus to the trigger. Matching table columns are adjacent pairs source item→ERP item and source vendor→ERP vendor. All new/modified pages follow AGENTS.md and docs/UI_LAYOUT_AND_MENU_CONTRACT.md keyboard-accessibility rules.
criteriaLedger.priceCellUi: the source customer×product cell has a directly editable numeric KRW input. A populated price is rendered as digits only without a trailing 원 marker, and the edit table shows the ERP estimate unit without a repeated 원/ prefix. Typing updates the shared draft immediately and same-source product/color cells for configured included customers with the same or unresolved ERP product identity reflect one bulk price; explicitly excluded customers keep independent customer-product prices. The ‘일괄업체 설정’ dialog has a global enabled toggle, per-customer ‘일괄 제외’ checkboxes, search and explicit save/cancel. Default excludes 주광; saved config follows local drafts and immutable work snapshots. Config changes preserve/migrate unique existing values and never silently resolve conflicting amounts; collisions show a review message. Escape restores the value at edit start; blur/Enter keep the current draft. Existing busy guards apply. Desktop visual scale is 70% at the required 1920×1080 viewport; at <=1100px it returns to 100%. Quantity and price are centered with zero cell padding.
criteriaLedger.safeAlias: within active Netherlands products and the same FlowerName only, a terminal (NL) country marker may be omitted from an otherwise exact item name. Duplicates and color/size substitutions remain unmatched; no fuzzy automatic selection.
criteriaLedger.customerHeader: Dutch-only active customer exact matching splits name and code lines. Unique exact CustName/Descr-head and exact OrderCode candidate sets must agree when both exist. If only one set exists it must be unique. No substring CL2/CL22 or arbitrary YCL prefix equivalence. Explicit manual keys retain precedence. Trusted CustKey source hints are restricted to the current authenticated LIVE workbook/header mapping and active keys in the same pivot response; user-uploaded keymaps do not populate explicit keys.
criteriaLedger.customerIdentity: pivot rows expose the legacy name-keyed orders map unchanged plus ordersByCustKey for identity-safe exports. The Dutch exporter uses customersByKey/ordersByCustKey where present. LIVE-generated hidden keymap rows must match one exact (sheet, visible customer-name+code label) and one active CustKey from the same pivot-data response; the result is stored separately as sourceCustKey, included in draft identity, and cannot be overwritten by persisted automatic matching. Manual custKey remains a distinct explicit override. Duplicate labels/keys stay on exact structured matching. Generic uploads ignore hidden keymaps.
criteriaLedger.previewComparison: two reads and locked snapshot protection remain required; compare sorted full row/unmatched tuples as multisets so SQL order alone is not a change. Keep duplicates, quantities, fix state, date issues and unmatched reasons in the comparison.
criteriaLedger.draftIdentity: v3 draft uses source-entry content fingerprint with selected year/week; restore only editable fields and keep original source labels. Old v2 drafts are retained in storage but not silently restored; show a review notice.
criteriaLedger.quantity: only finite numeric values greater than zero become price-entry rows
criteriaLedger.alstroUnit: Pivot exporter divides Alstro order OutQuantity by16. Dutch input never guesses that factor: a positive matched Alstro entry without explicit unit blocks server plan issuance. User selects box/bunch/stem to use Product conversion factors. Zero omitted cleanup does not require input unit. Snapshot includes FlowerName so source changes invalidate plans.
criteriaLedger.matching: Dutch Pivot product is often FlowerName while color contains the actual item name. Resolve exact normalized full/cleaned item labels including color within active Netherlands products; ambiguous candidates remain unmatched. Explicit ERP keys remain authoritative and invalid keys fail closed. A current blocked validation is displayed as current, but never enables apply without its server plan token.
criteriaLedger.price: configured included customers share one uniform price by product and color; excluded customers use an independent customer-product key, and disabling bulk makes every customer individual. Default bulk enabled/excludes source names containing 주광. Entering a price on an included row updates included peers for the same source product/color and same or unresolved ERP product identity; configured exclusions and distinct explicit product rematches remain separate. Config edits migrate a common price when unique and report conflicts without picking an arbitrary value. For ERP apply, blank means preserve price and explicit finite zero or positive KRW is valid; export draft completion is separate from ERP apply eligibility.
criteriaLedger.keyboard: Enter prevents form submission and focuses/selects the next visible price input
criteriaLedger.export: both live-download and uploaded-workbook paths preserve the Pivot workbook; locally edited customer weekday cells in row 2 export at their original coordinates, without changing ERP customer master data; all Pivot titles use 차수(...) newline 품종(...); explicitly edited customer quantity cells export the final numeric draft quantity while untouched source quantities, formulas, used range and worksheet columns remain unchanged; all Netherlands customer columns use one equal 10-character width and names wrap naturally to available cell width with CL/order code retained on its own lower line; quantity values remain numeric and top-aligned; price digits appear only in a compact zero-inset bordered speech-callout in the lower portion of that same quantity cell, pointer above the price, never crossing its cell boundary; only rows with a price label grow to 30pt; exported workbook adds no visible label containing 단가 and price decoration never mutates quantity values or emits @/EUR/KRW
criteriaLedger.currency: Dutch apply input is KRW only; legacy EUR or unknown-currency draft is never reinterpreted as KRW. Blank unitPrice means preserve existing line price or use existing ERP fallback for a new line; explicit finite unitPrice >=0, including zero, is valid. The downloaded volume-sheet quantity cell shows digits without a currency suffix.
criteriaLedger.replacement: CountryFlower CATEGORY_REPLACE: same-year same-week existing order/shipment pairs for all active Netherlands products in uploaded categories are in scope; omitted pairs final shipment zero, order preserved; outside category/year/week preserved. Preview, locked apply recheck and readback share readDutchScopeSnapshot.
criteriaLedger.priceBasis: Product.EstUnit with ClassShipmentDate.UpdateCost rounded EstQuantity amount/VAT; price-only does not mutate quantity, shipment dates or farm rows.
criteriaLedger.plan: Server-side owner-bound single-use plan; category membership, masters, orders, shipments, dates, farms, Product conversion and CustomerProdCost fallback are hashed and checked after held locks before any write. Positive pairs require one native ViewOrder and ViewShipment row and exact ShipmentDate-PeriodDay datetime join in the selected year and major week before commit; price readback checks both detail and every date Amount/Vat.
criteriaLedger.workSnapshot: Owner is the authenticated non-empty userId and maps only to a SHA-256 directory. Each save is a new server-UUID immutable JSON; no update/delete/cross-owner/admin exception. Persist JSON-safe workbook, ordered entries with manual keys and added rows, prices with blank versus explicit zero, bulk-price enabled/excluded-customer config, original source mode/name, exact saved year/week and source identity. Server authors savedAt/savedBy and ignores client audit fields. Exclude automatic match cache, preview, planToken, acknowledgements, apply job/result/log. Reject request or stored JSON over 900 KiB, over 5000 entries, or over 32 sheets. List metadata only, owner-wide newest first with bounded cursor pages. Restore requires confirmation, suppresses live/local-draft replacement, clears every validation/apply state, and can reach apply only after a fresh preview. Final apply first archives the exact current work while editing is frozen and sends no ERP POST if archive fails. Excel export remains a separate action.
